color.note: Midnight Editorial. One light theme; dark bands (hero, CTA, footer) are sections painted with midnight, not a separate theme. Antique Gold is reserved for the primary call-to-action and key highlights.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Primary dark. Hero, closing CTA band and footer backgrounds; heading text on studio-light and warm-parchment (16:1).

tokens.name: ink-navy
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces inside midnight sections (founder card in the hero, code panels, share image panels).

tokens.name: harbor-blue
tokens.usage: Secondary surfaces, eyebrow labels and text links on light grounds (9.8:1 on studio-light), stat and step numerals on parchment.

tokens.name: antique-gold
tokens.usage: ONLY the primary button fill, key highlights (rules, metric underlines) and eyebrows/links on midnight (7.3:1). Never text on light grounds (2.2:1).

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill; midnight text on it stays above 8:1.

tokens.name: warm-parchment
tokens.usage: Alternate section background (trust strip, services, how we work, FAQ).

tokens.name: studio-light
tokens.usage: Main page background.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Card surfaces on studio-light and warm-parchment.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on studio-light, warm-parchment and paper.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions and meta on studio-light (7.0:1) and warm-parchment (6.5:1).

tokens.name: text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on midnight, ink-navy and harbor-blue (9:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-muted-on-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on midnight (9.2:1), ink-navy (7.7:1) and harbor-blue (5.6:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines on light grounds. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: hairline-on-dark
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers on midnight and ink-navy.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Form control borders on studio-light and paper (3.7:1), meets the 3:1 control floor.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light grounds: 2px solid outline, 3px offset.

tokens.name: focus-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside midnight sections: 2px solid outline, 3px offset.

families.sans: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page H1 at desktop. Drops to 40px / 44px on mobile.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Case study metrics, stats and step numbers.

styles.name: quote

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase tracked label above every H2. harbor-blue on light, antique-gold on midnight.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We make it easier for your customers to find answers.
styles.usage: Hero subheads and section intros. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body

styles.name: small
styles.sample: We reply within one business day.
styles.usage: Captions, meta, footer links, form hints.
